correctness.rationale: The claim is finite and exhaustive. The verifier rebuilds all 32 binary words, proves that the asymmetric-distance adjacency and disjoint one-error Z-ball adjacency coincide on every pair, enumerates every maximal clique, obtains maximum size 6 and exactly 120 maximizers, and then recomputes the complete order-240 symmetry action. The three orbit sizes sum to 120 and their stabilizer orders agree with orbit--stabilizer. No infinite inference is drawn from sampling.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification at a classical finite Z-channel parameter, not an arbitrary slice. The optimum value is already known, but equality is not rigid: the 120 optima split into three inequivalent symmetry types with different stabilizers. The exact equality layer therefore supplies a reusable finite benchmark for constructions, searches, and symmetry reductions in asymmetric coding.
